memory.design: bake RGBA8 with mips 14.0 MB on GPU (2048 x 1280); this mockup holds CPU canvases instead of GPU textures, plus the CPU rasters the checks read

times.design: GPU bake: a few ms to 15 ms on a GPU (estimate); CPU fallback 1.3 s at 1024 and 3.3 s at 2048 (measured under load in the research)
